messages:
Maya: FYI noticed a config drift between staging and the dedicated pool after the routing change earlier. staging shows snapshot sn_2026_04_02_12, dedicated still on sn_2026_04_01_09

Sam: confirmed. Dedicated returned an error during reconcile: "etag mismatch" when applying the new snapshot.

Lia: can you paste the snapshot ids and the reconcile logs? we need to see if apply retried.

Sam: staging: sn_2026_04_02_12, dedicated: sn_2026_04_01_09. Audit shows apply event then `reconcile_failed: etag_mismatch`.

TJ: that's our optimistic concurrency kicking in. Console probably saved without first fetching latest etag.

Maya: console shows user ops-oncall saved at 12:07 but the client didn't GET latest before PATCH.

devops-bot: deploy-log: config-apply sn_2026_04_02_12 -> target:deds-gpu-pool status: partial_failure

Lia: this is dangerous for routing.policies and quotas. If shards are out of sync traffic routing diverges. We need a safer UI flow + API contract.

Sam: API idea: require an If-Match header on PATCH /v1/configs/{id} and return 412 on mismatch. UI can then show conflict modal.

TJ: agree with If-Match semantics. We also need a merge-preview endpoint so the console can show a 3-way diff instead of blind overwrite.

Maya: UX: prefer not to hard-lock. Soft-lock + owner contact flow: show "Another snapshot is active" with option to request edit or open merge modal. Hard locks will block ops.

Lia: product note: add a policy for targeted shard edits — show active rollout windows if a snapshot is propagating to a shard and prevent concurrent edits to that same shard for N minutes.

Sam: telemetry plan: emit events config.apply.attempt, config.apply.conflict, config.merge.preview with tags: env, target_shard, snapshot_id, user, conflict_type.

TJ: backend: implement POST /v1/configs/{id}/merge-preview that accepts base_snapshot, incoming_patch and returns unified diff as plain text plus conflict hunks. Will need a simple 3-way merge lib for our subset of config schema (routing, quotas).

Maya: Security: sensitive keys cannot be shown even in diffs. Replace secret values with [REDACTED] placeholders.

security: acknowledged. Diffs must never include plaintext secrets. Only metadata (key present/missing) is allowed for secrets.

Sam: dashboard idea: "Config Reconciliations" panel showing conflicts over time, broken down by target_shard and user, with a link to most recent diff. Also a heatmap of hours when conflicts spike.

Lia: ops playbook change: add post-apply verification that runs at T+30s and T+5m. If snapshot doesn't match on target, emit `config.snapshot.verify_failed` metric and trigger a reconciliation job. If still failing, auto-create a ticket with diffs attached.

TJ: short-term increment: 1) add If-Match handling and return 412, 2) console UX to catch 412 and show instructive modal, 3) telemetry event for conflicts. Longer term: merge-preview + reconciliation automation.

Maya: timeline: can we ship If-Match + 412 + basic modal by end of week? low-risk. Merge-preview prototype next sprint.

Sam: I'll add telemetry and a Grafana panel stub in staging within 3 days.

TJ: I'll prototype merge-preview endpoint and a tiny merge lib for routing/quotas (7 days).

Lia: I'll author the interim runbook note and update the console help text.

Maya: one more: API debate — PATCH with If-Match vs a dedicated apply endpoint that takes snapshot_id + strategy (reject|merge|force). Thoughts?

Sam: PATCH+If-Match keeps RESTy semantics and leverages HTTP tooling. Dedicated apply endpoint is explicit and might be clearer for the merge strategy param.

TJ: lean PATCH+If-Match for normal edits. Add POST /apply for operator-level force-merges that require extra auth and produce audit entries.

Lia: agree. force-merge must be gated (enterprise teams/ops-only) and always generate a reconciliation job.

devops-bot: runbook: https://internal/runbooks/config-conflict updated with quick CLI commands.

Maya: good. I'll open a small PR to add If-Match header handling in the console and improve the save flow to re-fetch etag before applying.

Sam: logging examples I'll emit:

`config.apply.attempt {"snapshot":"sn_2026_04_02_12","target":"deds-gpu-pool","user":"maya","etag":"a1b2"}`

`config.apply.conflict {"snapshot":"sn_2026_04_02_12","target":"deds-gpu-pool","user":"maya","reason":"etag_mismatch"}`

TJ: and merge-preview response will look like:

```
--- base/sn_2026_04_01_09
+++ incoming
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 routing.policies[0].priority: 10 -> 5
 quota.targets.deds-gpu-pool.tokens: 100000 -> 120000
 <<<< CONFLICT at routing.policies[2] >>>>
```
Lia: make sure UI shows clear affordances to accept/reject hunks and to create a new snapshot from the merged result.

Maya: ok locking down next steps: Maya: console PR (etag + 412 modal), Sam: telemetry + dashboards, TJ: merge-preview scaffold, Lia: runbook + help text. Security: ensure diffs redact secrets.

Maya: thanks all. tagging @security for visibility. will follow up with PR links in thread. :rocket:
